plain_baseline: Competent general economic ideation with the common seed/memory pool, identical card schema and budget; no prescribed mechanism transformations.

controls.expected_check: flag uncertain semantic/mechanism overlap; never certify economic identity
refuse documented link without supplied provenance
refuse absent seed or inexact source quote
refuse first-public time inferred from event or document date
refuse malformed stage order; substantive coherence still requires review
flag missing meaningful falsification for review
do not equate coherence or strong evidence with novelty
retain in incubator with a concrete reconsideration requirement

metrics.mechanism_diversity: Distinct frozen mechanism-family categories and mechanism/evidence niches; show sector, role, lane, requirement and pathway counts separately.
metrics.duplicates: Exact core duplicates / all imported cards; uncertain proximity pairs shown separately, never counted as confirmed duplicates.
metrics.structural_coherence: Mechanical chain/schema consistency count; substantive economic coherence remains a separate independent reviewer judgment.
metrics.falsifiability: Explicit checkable falsifier count and independent reviewer judgment; never inferred from nonempty prose alone.
metrics.evidence_integrity: Invalid provenance cases / attempted imports, with raw invalid responses preserved; semantic entailment requires human review.
metrics.novelty: Internal proximity, external evidence-backed review and structural mechanism review reported separately; NOT_CHECKED never becomes novel.
metrics.feasibility: Counts by documented, untested, inaccessible, unknown and stopped route; no route becomes acquisition authority.
metrics.workload: All recorded human minutes, unknown entries and uninvestigated candidates remain in the denominator.
metrics.handoffs_per_human_hour: Human-approved distinct handoff proposals / all human hours; null when any required time or review is missing.
metrics.false_rejections_of_speculation: Reviewed coherent speculative controls routed REJECT / independently judged coherent speculative controls; null without independent judgments.
metrics.jev: Per-question agreement, errors and Brier score only against available independent binary human labels; separate deterministic and critic comparisons; missing labels explicit. Never claim calibration from this small demonstration.

blinding: Common card format, generator/model/lane/IDs/routing hidden behind a sealed mapping; same owner may operate and review, so partial procedural blinding only.
analysis: Descriptive only. No composite quality score, significance claim, adaptive policy, fake reviewer labels or scientific/investment conclusion. Missing or unequal-budget conditions remain incomplete. Synthetic controls and operator-generated speculative examples are never pooled as real evidence.
